name: Slowly Changing Dimension Type 2 Join with Open-Ended Future
description: Customers change addresses or account tiers over time. Joining historical orders to customer profile dimensions requires matching the order date to the active validity interval.
prompt:
Customers change addresses or account tiers over time. Joining historical orders to customer profile dimensions requires matching the order date to the active validity interval.

Execute the required analytical SQL calculation in DuckDB.
Expected output columns: order_id, customer_id, order_date, amount, customer_tier_at_purchase.
Results should be ordered as specified.
golden_sql:
-- Join fact orders to historical customer dimension without dropping active records
            SELECT 
                o.order_id,
                o.customer_id,
                o.order_date,
                o.amount,
                c.tier AS customer_tier_at_purchase
            FROM fact_orders o
            JOIN dim_customer_scd c
              ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
             AND o.order_date >= c.valid_from
             AND o.order_date < COALESCE(c.valid_to, DATE '9999-12-31')
            ORDER BY o.order_id;
why_it_fails: Current active records typically have `valid_to IS NULL`. A simple `order_date BETWEEN valid_from AND valid_to` drops all current active records.
